fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding/swing metal gate across the truck driveway through a tall wrought-iron perimeter fence on the Owensmouth Ave (east) frontage, seen in Jan-2026 Street View at ~34.2373,-118.6024.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure beside the gate - the entrance is just a gate in the fence line.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with a small call-box/intercom post beside it and no guard shack - remote/kiosk-style check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Recessed dock doors face the fenced east yard inside the perimeter; ~6 estimated, partly obscured by roof overhang and trees - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated drop lot; a couple of box trucks/trailers seen in the alley and yard - small capacity.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The fenced east yard inside the gate functions as a small paved holding/dock-approach area before the doors.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense San Fernando Valley industrial park, Chatsworth - clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box - constrained urban legacy parcel, ~4-5 acres including building footprint and surface parking.

citations.claim: Danone North America's own locations page lists this plant at "9201 Owensmouth Ave. Chatsworth, CA 91311". Our roster address for this record is "9201 Owensmouth Avenue, Chatsworth, CA 91311", which matches at street level, and the record's coordinates were geocoded from that address.

divestitureCheck.method: Danone's own locations page is its current operating list, so presence on it is positive evidence the plant is still running. Cross-checked against the 2026 restructuring, which named Bridgeton NJ as the closure and named Mount Crawford, Dallas and Jacksonville as receiving its volume.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the current company locations page; not closed or divested

sources.covers: the 2026 Danone North America manufacturing restructuring and the single US plant closure it produced

verification.claimScope: address-level identity from the operator's own published facility list, plus a geocode of that address. Not an independent parcel survey.
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: Danone North America publishes this plant on its own locations page with a full street address, and that address matches this record's roster address at street level. The record's coordinates were geocoded from that same address. Identity is therefore address-level from the operator itself; it is not an independent parcel survey. The same page is the operating-status check: it is Danone's current facility list, and the only one of our 13 published Danone sites missing from it is Bridgeton NJ, which Danone closed on 2026-08-02.
